summary: Feature-Flag Console denies access after Okta group attribute format change (role scope mismatch)
description:
Issue summary:
A small subset of internal users are receiving 403 when opening the Feature-Flag Console (console.redwood.internal). The requests authenticate successfully via Okta SSO, but the console denies RBAC role binding due to an unexpected group claim format.

Impact:
- ~12 engineers across a couple of teams cannot view or modify feature flags.
- Blocks on-call debugging and staged rollouts for two services (payments, telemetry).
- Not customer-facing but affects internal release velocity and incident response.

Observed behavior:
- User completes Okta SSO and is redirected to console, then immediately sees a 403 page with "insufficient permissions" message.
- Identity payload in logs shows groups claim present, but group strings do not match RBAC matcher.

Expected behavior:
- Okta groups map to internal RBAC roles and users with the matching groups have access to the Feature-Flag Console.

Notes: This ticket covers the support investigation; follow-up work (config rollouts) will be tracked separately.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Use an affected user account (example: aisha.k@redwood.test)
2) Navigate to https://console.redwood.internal/flags
3) Click Sign in with Okta and complete MFA
4) Observe redirect to 403 page instead of dashboard

Repro on-off: reproducible for affected users and their sessions; other users unaffected.
logs:
Auth proxy logs (excerpt):
- RequestId: rq-93a2f
- SSO assertion validated, issuer=accounts.okta.com/xx
- groups claim: ["eng-team_42", "release-managers-2026"]
- RBAC lookup: attempted match against roleBindings: ["eng-team-42", "release-managers"]
- Result: no exact match -> deny -> 403

Console debug log: roleBinding resolution failed: claim string mismatch (underscore vs hyphen).
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: A recent Okta attribute transform rolled out a prefixed format for group names (underscore insertion) for certain synced groups. RBAC matcher expects hyphenated names; therefore roleBindings don't match.

What we checked:
- Okta SCIM sync jobs ran at 2026-03-09 03:12 UTC; group metadata changed for two groups (team id appended with underscore in 'displayName').
- No recent RBAC config changes on the console side in the last 30 days.
- Identity proxy (auth-proxy) normalizes group names only in one code path; discrepancy occurs when claims come from SAML vs OIDC, and the new transform applies only to SAML assertions.

Telemetry: Started seeing first 403 errors for feature-flag console at ~2026-03-09 03:20 UTC correlated with SCIM sync window.

Quick test: Rewrote a binding in dev to match underscore variant and login succeeded for the test user. This confirms mapping mismatch.

Potential root cause: Okta attribute transform for displayName added an underscore-delimited suffix for certain migrated groups. RBAC matching uses exact string equality instead of canonical normalization.

Related risk: If we apply a broad normalization change to RBAC, it could affect many bindings; need targeted fix.
